research_principles: First pass must be deterministic and must not use ML.
Each family should use at most one higher-timeframe context, one setup, one confirmation and one fixed execution policy.
Preregister a small hypothesis list before viewing outcomes.
Do not reopen broad threshold, month, direction, D1, volatility, window or cooldown rescue.
Require fresh no-backfill prospective evidence before any promotion.
prohibited: No Stage55 model, Q70, confirmation, stop, target or hold changes.
No huge grid search disguised as a simple-rule study.
No use of Discord delivery or visual impressions as selection labels.
No MT5 orders, live trading, live-ready or final signal.
